coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: the search backend responded to all 12 queries but returned a disproportionately irrelevant and stale result set, notably international hospitals, so this run cannot claim reliable independent U.S. local/territorial recall.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded supplementary watch; Sunday morning local reporting may not yet be indexed. Search quality materially limits recall, especially rural communities and territories. Absence of new verified findings is not proof of absence.
coverage_notes.controls: Append-only heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. No editorial approval, public publication, production collector mutation, schedule change, or task disabling.
